mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (id, order_id, customer_name, worker_name, score, tags, type, content, status, created_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{customerName}, #{workerName}, #{score}, #{tags}, #{type}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, customer_name AS customer, worker_name AS worker, score, tags, type, content, status, created_time AS createdTime FROM review WHERE customer_name = #{customerName} ORDER BY created_time DESC
SELECT id, status FROM review WHERE id = #{id}
